verdict.rationale: Dynadot is a domain registrar and SaaS account platform that holds customer data, so letting users choose a storage region is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions data residency, storage regions, or region selection. WHOIS privacy, SSL, and account security are adjacent privacy features and do not deliver residency choice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
